verdict.rationale: Evidence shows workflow suspend/resume for human-in-the-loop approval (mastra-gh-4, mastra-docs-12) but nothing about versioning workflow definitions, reviewing changes, or rolling back automations to a prior state — these are code-based workflows relying on external git tooling, not a built-in version/review/rollback system. Missing for 10: any documentation of automation versioning, change review/approval workflow, or rollback mechanism for deployed automations.
